mathematics.assertion_tested: Independent exact bounded checks of sequence definitions, OGF/EGF normalization, residue-channel reconstruction, FIR routing/composition, Haar alignment, streaming state, and discrete rational resampling.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Z and Q; root-of-unity selectors are checked in exact Q[t]/Phi_m(t) for m=2,...,6.
mathematics.conventions: Fibonacci F0=0,F1=1; causal sequences vanish at negative indices; OGF channels use q per m-sample block; EGF phases retain their original factorials; tangent sequence index starts at 1; tribonacci initials 0,0,1; tetranacci initials 0,0,0,1; positive secant coefficients; Haar high channel is even minus odd; no author generator imports.
non_claims: Finite checks do not prove universal sequence identities or supply external source authentication.
A finite recurrence annihilator is not the impulse response of its inverse.
No continuous reconstruction, anti-alias accuracy, or floating-point stability claim.
No root-of-unity selector claim in characteristics dividing the modulus.
